title: A^2Agent: Action-Aware Reinforcement Learning for Repository-Level Code Localization Agents
abstract: arXiv:2608.29831v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Localizing issue-relevant code regions is a critical step in automated software engineering. However, due to their reliance on sparse trajectory-level signals, existing methods cannot identify which per-turn actions are effective and often discover correct code regions during exploration but fail to commit them. To address these limitations, we propose an action-aware reinforcement learning method that combines a per-turn reward sequence rewarding both the discovery and commitment of gold code regions with an action-level advantage estimation scheme that isolates each action's credit by grouping turns sharing the same exploration context. Extensive evaluations show that our method improves the average F1 over the state-of-the-art (SOTA) by 1.58% on SWE-Bench Verified and 8.55% on SWE-Bench Pro, with our 4B model outperforming baselines up to 8x larger. Our code is available at https://github.com/donian00/A2Agent.

translated_title: A^2Agent：面向仓库级代码定位智能体的动作感知强化学习
translated_abstract: 定位与问题相关的代码区域是自动化软件工程中的关键步骤。然而，由于依赖稀疏的轨迹级信号，现有方法无法识别每一轮中哪些动作是有效的，并且经常在探索过程中发现了正确的代码区域却未能将其提交。为了解决这些局限，我们提出了一种动作感知的强化学习方法，该方法将同时奖励标准代码区域的发现与提交的逐轮奖励序列，与动作级优势估计方案相结合，后者通过将共享相同探索上下文的轮次分组来隔离每个动作的贡献。大量评估表明，我们的方法在SWE-Bench Verified上将平均F1较最先进方法（SOTA）提升了1.58%，在SWE-Bench Pro上提升了8.55%，且我们的4B模型性能超越了规模最大达8倍的基线模型。我们的代码已在 https://github.com/donian00/A2Agent 开源。
tldr: 提出动作感知强化学习方法A^2Agent，通过逐轮奖励序列和动作级优势估计解决稀疏轨迹信号无法识别有效动作的问题，显著提升仓库级代码定位性能，4B模型可超越规模大8倍的基线。
en_tdlr: A^2Agent introduces action-aware reinforcement learning combining per-turn reward sequences with action-level advantage estimation to identify effective actions in sparse trajectory signals, improving repository-level code localization with a 4B model that outperforms baselines up to 8x larger.
